The scope is the twelve paths that commit changes: README.md, SHA256SUMS, verify.sh and records/toolchain.txt, which it edits, and the files it adds, records/zm_full/ (the full zm_mixed pass's per-root records, manifest and log, and the depth-34 rerun of one root) and tools/check_full.py. claims: The second route for T-184's covering statement: zm_mixed.py cert --d4 --cert-mode --disj --chain-from 0 --pitch 1/20 --ubins 16 --depth 24 (ee3e2915, exact rationals), with mixed_cover.py bb89de15 and zeromargin.py 640fe453, alone over all 129,600 D4 roots of 1/20 x 1/20 x 1/32 of cover/s76_cover_v5.txt (SHA-256 b6a1214b99f00e5dd136d74c8d87bccd178df38a1063b2c7be90517eb2b862b2), 2,227,114 boxes, certifies 129,599 roots and leaves 6 boxes in one root R = [27/20, 7/5] x [13/10, 27/20] x [1/4, 9/32], which the same checker certifies alone at depth 34 (13,767 boxes, none uncertified); so the covering statement holds by zm_mixed alone, without zmx2 (README.md, records/zm_full/, records/toolchain.txt)

The full pass took 651,314 CPU-s (181 CPU-hours) over 27,729 s of wall on 24 processes, 2026-10-13 19:31 to 2026-10-14 03:13 CDT, and the rerun of R 2,661 CPU-s (records/toolchain.txt, records/zm_full/rerun_R_depth34.log)

tools/check_full.py checks the records: every root of the region has a record, each header names the cover and the pinned checker files, and each root is certified in the full run or a rerun; verify.sh applies it to the shipped records by default and, with --full-zm, reruns the pass and the reruns listed in records/zm_full/rerun.txt (README.md, verify.sh, tools/check_full.py)
